easy.def: Tiny sea animals that whales eat.
examples: A cloud of krill floated in the sea.

more.def: Tiny shrimp-like animals that live in huge groups in the ocean and are food for whales, seals and penguins.
examples: Blue whales eat tons of krill every day.
Krill swim together in huge swarms in the cold ocean.
Penguins and seals also feed on krill.

easy.def: A giant sea reptile with a huge head and sharp teeth.
examples: A kronosaurus lived in the sea.

more.def: A huge sea reptile with a giant head and sharp teeth, which swam in the oceans at the time of the dinosaurs.
examples: The kronosaurus had a head as long as a car.
A kronosaurus swam using four flippers.
Fossils of the kronosaurus were found in Australia.
